macro_theme: Agricultural Contaminant Loss via Tile Drainage
macro_description: This umbrella theme spans the export of nutrients (nitrate, phosphorus), agrochemicals (herbicides, pesticides), and microbial contaminants (bacteria, manure-derived pathogens) from agricultural fields through subsurface tile drainage systems. It encompasses the soil structural and hydrological controls governing these losses, their quantification and modeling, and the influence of drainage and land management practices on contaminant concentrations and fluxes.
member_themes: Nitrate and Nutrient Loss via Drainage; Soil Macroporosity and Drainage-Induced Structure; Phosphorus Loss Pathways and Soil Controls; Tile Drain Nitrate Loss Model Calibration; Nitrate-N Losses Under Drainage Management; Manure Application Effects on Soil and Drainage Microbiology; Herbicide Loss Timing and Concentrations in Drainage

macro_description: This umbrella theme spans the hydrological, agronomic, and environmental outcomes of controlled and subsurface drainage systems—including effects on water flow, salt leaching, and crop yield—as well as the socio-economic costs and benefits that determine the practical viability of drainage investment.
member_themes: Controlled Drainage Effects on Flow and Losses; Subsurface Drainage for Soil Salt Leaching; Drainage Management and Crop Yield Improvement; Socio-Economic Benefits of Drainage Investment

macro_theme: Drainage System Flow Modeling and Dynamics
macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses the simulation, calibration, and performance evaluation of models describing water movement through tile drainage systems, spanning water table prediction, streamflow responses to drainage events, pipe flow equations, and comparative benchmarking of modeling approaches.
member_themes: Subsurface Drainage Model Performance Evaluation; Tile Drainage Influence on Streamflow Dynamics; Model Performance Evaluation and Comparison; Numerical Modeling of Pipe Flow Dynamics

macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses research on how cover crops—particularly winter rye—reduce nitrate leaching and drainage losses in tile-drained agricultural systems. It spans studies examining cover crop biomass, species selection, and cropping management practices (including corn-soybean rotations) as strategies to mitigate nitrate export while maintaining crop yields.
member_themes: Cover Crops and Management Reducing Nitrate Loss; Rye Cover Crop Nitrate Drainage Reduction

macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses treatment technologies that use reactive media—woodchip bioreactors for denitrification-based nitrate removal and slag or adsorptive materials for phosphate removal—to intercept and reduce nutrient loads from tile drainage effluent.
member_themes: Woodchip Bioreactor Nitrate Removal Performance; Phosphorus Removal via Reactive Media

macro_description: This umbrella theme encompasses the use of remote sensing technologies—including GPR, thermal infrared, UAV imagery, and related geospatial methods—to detect, map, and characterize subsurface tile drainage networks. It spans efforts to non-invasively locate buried drain pipes and delineate drainage system layouts across agricultural landscapes.
